intro: The Water Sapta is a ceremonial draught used to attune one's spiritual sight to the hidden spirits and corruptions of water. Entrusted with this preparation, the bearer is sent to locate tainted pond water within the fields of Westfall to investigate an elemental imbalance.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Take the water sapta and find the tainted pond water in Westfall, friend. I have great faith in your abilities.
